column1: # W3C XML conformance: known parser failures.
# Each row is a result that the current parser is known to get wrong. Listed rows
# are still failures: junit.xml shows them as failures marked [known: ...] and
# summary.md counts them under "Known". They only stop failing the build.
# The run still fails when
#   - any failure or error is NOT listed here (a new problem), or
#   - a listed case passes or changes status (update this list: it was fixed or changed).
# History:
#   2026-10-23  519 rows recorded (Finalized 236 failed; FinalizedAssertions 236 failed,
#               47 errors), the same totals as the Jenkins build of main cf12dee.
#   2026-10-23  All 519 fixed in the parser; the list is empty. Every applicable case
#               (1,727 per build) must pass.
#   2026-10-26  Expanded to 1,909 applicable cases per build; all pass in both
#               finalized assertion modes. The list remains empty.
#   2026-10-27  Expanded to 1,974 applicable cases per build with local resources;
#               all pass in both assertion modes; no allowlist rows added.
#               The documented E38 fifth-edition correction retains both expectations.
# Add a row only for a confirmed parser gap with an open issue, using
# scripts/run_w3c_conformance.py --write-known-failures <file> to get its exact form.
